2.text: First, ensure your hours are accurate - and double-check them regularly
Next, upload high-quality photos that showcase your business, your team

3.text: If you’re a plumber in Your City, use that exact phrase on your profile and your website.
“Plumber in Your City” is what people type into Google.
On your website, make sure there’s one clear, prominent button that says “Call Now.
” Nothing else matters for the first few seconds.

4.text: Make sure your hours, photos, and service areas are exactly right.
If you mess this up, you lose the first chance to be seen.
A poorly managed GBP is like having a sign that says “Closed” when you’re actually open.
Reviews matter significantly more than your website for local search.

5.text: If you don’t match what people search for, you won’t show up.
On your website, make it incredibly simple.
Put one clear, easy-to-find “Call Now” button somewhere prominent on every page.
It should be visually distinct and easy to click.
Don’t hide it in a footer or bury it in a navigation menu.
